memo.summary: Context-only shadow memo, as of 2026-09-10: the market state is MIXED (59/100). The confirmed US regime remains Q3/stagflation, but its own axes currently read Q2/reflation (growth +0.20, inflation +0.84), with only 1 of 7 confirmation sessions completed. Risk Radar is WATCH, led by an unconfirmed growth/defensive-rotation leg; its measured 21-session pullback rate is 13.0% versus a 17.8% base rate, so it is an early flag rather than an edge. Credit and funding remain calm (HY OAS 2.67%, VIX 16.46), while breadth is soft at 42.9% above the 50-day average and cross-asset confirmation diverges. Liquidity is expanding mechanically through an $87B TGA drawdown, not Fed balance-sheet growth; the RRP buffer is exhausted, making that tailwind transient. Factor evidence is immature: only nine panel dates, no Pair G records, zero graded factor-attention firings, no scorecard survivors, and the composite is not tradeable. No new hypothesis was staked because the available observations did not justify spending the limited metabolism budget.
what_fired: Risk Radar WATCH: growth scare/defensive rotation score 65.7, but the firing leg is unconfirmed and the state remains below its pullback base rate.
Global breadth watch includes a confirmed, accruing JPY-carry leg, while the overall context gate is not met.
US regime-label mismatch: confirmed Q3 versus raw-axis Q2, pending 1 of 7 sessions.
Cross-asset confirmation changed to diverge while dealer gamma changed from long to short; these are context-only tensions, not signals.
Three shadow attention records were written: regime-label transition mismatch; cross-asset divergence under calm credit; master-brain thesis-ledger integrity.
memo.contradictions_review: The confluence graph contains three display-only tensions: demand/tape versus the briefing across 29 ticker-level divergences; bonds/FX versus the equity-regime cross-asset confirmation; and rising put skew against one buy-lane name (AZO), which is de-escalation context only. Pair G is dormant because the factor panel has fewer than 60 dates, so absence of factor contradictions is lack of coverage, not agreement. The master-brain thesis review is impaired: all 15 returned theses remain open despite many passed check_by dates, and duplicate thesis IDs exist. Current broad contradictions do not provide clean, thesis-specific evidence sufficient to reclassify semiconductors, growth/value, Bitcoin, China, Treasuries, credit, or US-equity theses; overdue scoring must be repaired before their apparent agreement or conflict is trusted.

Master-brain thesis-ledger integrity — falsifier: resolve when every past-due thesis is scored or explicitly retired within five sessions and duplicate IDs are made unique; retain otherwise.
Factor coverage remains insufficient: nine panel dates versus the 60-date Pair G activation floor, with zero graded attention events. Do not interpret the empty contradiction ledger as confirmation.
